name: approach_vs_static_paired_eval
description: Held-out paired ASNE contrast with matched wording for unchanged scenes versus another agent or object entering the observed area.

items.text: A person waits beside a loading dock. A runner stands at the alley entrance.
Someone watches the end of a long hall. A service cart rests near the elevator doors.
A person looks toward a stair landing. Another tenant remains by the railing.
A person waits beside a loading dock. A runner enters from the alley entrance.
Someone watches the end of a long hall. A service cart rolls out from the elevator doors.
A person looks toward a stair landing. Another tenant walks down by the railing.
